title: Subtle comparison between UTC-aware and naive datetime
diff:
@@ -2,5 +2,5 @@
 
 def is_token_expired(expiry_timestamp: str) -> bool:
     """Check if given ISO formatted token timestamp has expired."""
-    expiry = datetime.fromisoformat(expiry_timestamp).replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
+    expiry = datetime.fromisoformat(expiry_timestamp)
     return datetime.now(timezone.utc) > expiry

ground_truth.description: Comparing timezone-aware datetime.now(timezone.utc) with naive datetime raises TypeError in Python 3.11.
